```{r}
read_safe <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  utils::read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

paths <- list(
  day_in_life = file.path("artefacts", "canonical_runs", "day_in_life_mode_comparison_v1", "comparison_summary.csv"),
  exp_a = file.path("artefacts", "canonical_runs", "experiment_a_presence_removal_v1", "experiment_a_summary.csv"),
  exp_b = file.path("artefacts", "canonical_runs", "experiment_b_functional_types_v1", "experiment_b_summary.csv"),
  exp_c = file.path("artefacts", "canonical_runs", "experiment_c_aridity_gradient_v1", "experiment_c_summary.csv")
)

fig_paths <- list(
  exp_a = file.path("artefacts", "canonical_runs", "experiment_a_presence_removal_v1", "experiment_a_presence_removal.png"),
  exp_b = file.path("artefacts", "canonical_runs", "experiment_b_functional_types_v1", "experiment_b_functional_types.png"),
  exp_c = file.path("artefacts", "canonical_runs", "experiment_c_aridity_gradient_v1", "experiment_c_aridity_gradient.png")
)

cmp_day <- read_safe(paths$day_in_life)
exp_a <- read_safe(paths$exp_a)
exp_b <- read_safe(paths$exp_b)
exp_c <- read_safe(paths$exp_c)
```

## Model Overview

`herbivoreTTR` couples a daily plant-growth backend with minute-resolution herbivore foraging.
This report is intentionally artefact-driven: it reads canonical scenario outputs from
`artefacts/canonical_runs/` rather than re-running ad hoc simulations.

## Day-in-Life Vignette

```{r}
if (is.null(cmp_day)) {
  cat("Day-in-life comparison artefact is missing. Run the targets bundle first.")
} else {
  knitr::kable(cmp_day, digits = 4, caption = "Day-in-life nutrient-targeting vs energy-only summary")
}
```

## Experiment A Summary

```{r}
if (is.null(exp_a)) {
  cat("Experiment A summary artefact is missing.")
} else {
  knitr::kable(exp_a, digits = 3, caption = "Experiment A (presence vs removal) summary metrics")
}
```

```{r}
if (file.exists(fig_paths$exp_a)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(fig_paths$exp_a)
}
```

## Scenario Traceability

All tables and figures above are generated from scenario artefacts in
`artefacts/canonical_runs/` using scenario IDs defined under `config/scenarios/`.
